He discovered Nix and NixOS while managing his personal homelab—an end-to-end system that handles routing, authoritative DNS, email, and Matrix services. The declarative, immutable, and reproducible nature of NixOS made managing this complex setup both efficient and rewarding.

As a Google Summer of Code contributor with the NixOS Foundation, Sinan built evanix, a Nix build scheduler powered by MILP and machine learning. He maintains a modular flake-based NixOS config and regularly uses Nix flakes to create portable dev environments.

redq – an eBPF-based firewall and observability daemon

Contributions to Nixpkgs and self-hosted tooling
